title: saran and foil dispenser
text: saran and foil dispenser. Sadly this wouldn't work for us because it opens to the right of the box and where we needed to install it on the wall, we wouldn't be able to load it.  Hubby tried to DIY and switch to the left - Eh.  Not possible due to design.  So, it ended up in the dumpster.  Now, IF you can manage a drawer position, or a wall mount that would allow a right end opening, might work for you.  Because we didn't get to actually use it - I can't comment on that.  Sigh.  It was heavier, and made with bamboo/or like.

product_metadata.title: Plastic Wrap Organizer for drawer | Saran Wrap, Aluminum Foil, Wax Paper and Plastic Wrap Dispenser with Cutter | Perfect Kitchen Organizer | Labels Included | Compatible with 12" Roll (3 Slot)
features: PREMIUM QUALITY - Our kitchen wrap organizer is made with premium thick bamboo to ensure there are no cracks or broken pieces. We want your kitchen organization to stay so we design our products to last!

CUT THE CLUTTER and have perfect kitchen drawer organization with our food wrap dispenser with cutter. Perfect for Aluminum foil, saran wrap, plastic wrap, cling wrap, wax paper and more. Your kitchen organization and storage will be that much better!

FUNCTIONAL DESIGN - Contains 3 slots for wraps and sticker labels. You will be able to label and organize all your wraps however you please. We've included multiple labels of each type of wrap as well, so if you wanted to use the product just as a saran wrap organizer or aluminum foil dispenser etc you could do so.
COMPATIBLE WITH MOST BRANDS - Perfect with Glad Wrap, Saran Wrap, Reynolds Wrap, Cut-Rite and more. NOT compatible with rolls that are wider than 12"

LIFETIME WARRANTY - We are so confident in the quality and value of our wrap dispenser we’re happy to provide a lifetime warranty and money back guarantee. If you are not 100% satisfied, please contact us so we can make it right. Feel free to purchase risk free!
